# AEMS

Apex Electronics Manufacturing Services Co., Ltd.

### Supplier Corporate & Manufacturing Capability Statement

Consumer Electronics Programs - Samsung, Apple

Document ID: AEMS-QA-SP-2026-014

Revision: 2.1

Issue date: 18 August 2026

Owner: Corporate Quality & Customer Engineering Classification: External - Controlled Capability Statement Primary site file: QF-880214, Volume 2, Section 7

Apex Electronics Manufacturing Services Co., Ltd.

88 Innovation Avenue, Yen Phong Industrial Park, Bac Ninh 16000, Vietnam

#### Company profile and supplier role

Apex Electronics Manufacturing Services Co., Ltd. (AEMS) is a synthetic global electronics manufacturing services and precision-module supplier used in this test package as a Foxconn-like shared supplier. AEMS supports new-product introduction, high-volume subassembly production, printed-board assembly, precision mechanical integration, final configuration, reliability screening and controlled logistics for branded consumer-electronics customers.

For customer programs described in this statement, AEMS acts as a contract manufacturer and approved production supplier rather than as the product brand owner. Customer design authorities retain ownership of finished-product specifications, regulatory declarations and market-release decisions. AEMS is responsible for process qualification, material traceability, manufacturing records, test execution within the agreed scope, change notification and shipment conformity.

###### Legal entity, headquarters and operational contacts

Registered supplier: Apex Electronics Manufacturing Services Co., Ltd. (AEMS)

Registered office: 88 Innovation Avenue, Yen Phong Industrial Park, Bac Ninh 16000, Vietnam Global commercial office: 26 Science Park Drive, Jurong Innovation District, Singapore 609931 Supplier quality representative: Mai Tran, Director - Corporate Quality & Compliance Customer engineering lead: Daniel Wu, Vice President - Consumer Electronics Programs

Commercial role: Tier-1 EMS supplier, precision subassembly manufacturer and NPI integration partner

###### Manufacturing network

The Bac Ninh campus is the primary controlled site for the programs covered by this statement. It contains SMT lines, automated optical inspection, selective soldering, clean assembly, precision torque stations, laser marking, environmental screening and pack-out areas. The site address used on shipping records and supplier declarations is 88 Innovation Avenue, Yen Phong Industrial Park, Bac Ninh 16000, Vietnam.

Customer-approved overflow and specialized processes may also be performed at AEMS Shenzhen Operations, 1888 Guangming Technology Road, Shenzhen, Guangdong 518107, China, and AEMS India Electronics Campus, Plot 42, SIPCOT Industrial Park, Sriperumbudur, Tamil Nadu 602105, India. Transfer of a controlled customer process between sites requires customer notification, line-equivalence evidence and release of the associated process-change package before mass production.

#### Customer program support

###### Samsung - Galaxy A56R 5G / Orion-R program

AEMS received Samsung program inquiry SAM-ORR-26-041 in May 2026 for manufacturing support associated with the Galaxy A56R 5G refresh, internally referenced as Orion-R. The customer package identifies

SM-A568B/DS for the EU/UK configuration and SM-A568U1 for the U.S. unlocked channel. The commercial response was issued under quotation QT-AEMS-260527-118 and covers DVT-to-ramp support at the Bac Ninh campus.

The approved supplier scope includes production of the USB-C/audio flex subassembly, stamped EMI shield-can set, camera-support bracket, adhesive die-cut kit and controlled final kitting for customer engineering builds.

Samsung retains final handset assembly at its designated manufacturing operation; AEMS ships qualified subassemblies with lot traceability, incoming-inspection evidence and process-conformance records.

For the DVT1 build, customer engineering requested controlled use of the released connector, gasket and adhesive revisions. Substitution of the USB-C receptacle, conductive gasket, pressure-sensitive adhesive or shield material is not permitted without an approved supplier change notice and customer disposition. AEMS test plan TP-SAM-ORR-DVT1-006 defines continuity, resistance, connector retention, dimensional inspection and sample-level thermal screening. The latest execution record, TR-SAM-ORR-006-03, was closed on 7 August 2026 with one process observation related to gasket compression that was corrected before the next build lot.

Expected program deliverables include first-article inspection reports, material declarations, process-flow release, DVT build records, change-notification package and serialized shipment manifest.

Customer target dates communicated to the supplier require regulatory release by 15 January 2027 and first commercial shipment beginning 16 February 2027.

###### Apple - iPhone 16 family manufacturing support

AEMS also maintains a separate synthetic NPI support assignment for Apple under opportunity APL-NPI-24-118. The scope is associated with the iPhone 16 family and is managed through Apple-controlled drawings and process specifications supplied to the AEMS customer engineering team. AEMS does not own the finished-product design; its assigned work is limited to precision mechanical subassemblies, flex-cable preparation, shielding components, controlled adhesive conversion and line-side kitting.

The latest commercial revision, quote QT-AEMS-240612-077 Rev C, covers tooling maintenance, production fixtures, in-process dimensional verification, cosmetic screening and traceable pack-out from the Shenzhen site. Materials used in the controlled scope include 300-series stainless steel for small structural parts, copper-nickel shielding foil, polyimide flexible-circuit substrates and customer-approved acrylic pressure-sensitive adhesives. Material lots are segregated by customer program and supplier certificate of conformance.

Customer acceptance conditions require that adhesive thickness, shield conductivity, cosmetic class and critical datum dimensions remain within the released process window. Any proposed alternate material or second-source conversion must be submitted through PCN AEMS-APL-xxxx with comparative inspection, reliability evidence and an updated material declaration before implementation. Qualification evidence is retained under controlled file QF-771906, Volume 5, Section 2.

#### Manufacturing capabilities and controlled processes

AEMS processes are selected by customer program and are released through program-specific control plans. The same process family may serve more than one customer, but fixtures, recipes, work instructions and material lots are segregated to prevent cross-program mixing. Key capabilities include high-density SMT, micro-coax and flex preparation, precision metal stamping, CNC secondary operations, laser welding, conductive-adhesive application, gasket placement, vision inspection, automated electrical test and serialized pack-out.

###### Printed-board and flex assembly

SMT production follows workmanship criteria based on IPC-A-610 and soldering controls aligned with J-STD-001 where invoked by the customer drawing. Paste lot, reflow profile, feeder setup, inspection result and repair disposition are retained against the manufacturing lot. Flex assemblies are handled with bend-radius protection and ESD controls; customer-defined contact resistance and continuity limits are verified before shipment.

###### Precision mechanical and shielding parts

AEMS forms and finishes stainless-steel, aluminum and copper-alloy parts used as internal brackets, shield covers, retention features and small structural elements. Raw-material certificates identify alloy, temper and heat/lot. Conductive shields may use nickel-plated stainless steel, copper-nickel foil or conductive fabric depending on the released customer specification. Critical dimensions are measured using optical systems and coordinate measurement equipment against the controlled drawing revision.

###### Adhesive, gasket and seal conversion

Die-cut conversion is performed in humidity-controlled areas for acrylic PSA, PET carrier films, conductive foams and elastomer gaskets. Each converted part is identified by AEMS internal trace code and the customer part number printed on the traveler. Release criteria include liner condition, cut geometry, thickness, compression behavior where applicable and material shelf life. This process is particularly controlled for handset ingress-sealing features and headset acoustic seals.

#### Quality, compliance and material governance

The synthetic AEMS quality system is structured around ISO 9001 quality-management practices and ISO 14001 environmental-management practices. Manufacturing controls also incorporate customer-specific requirements for ESD, product safety, restricted substances and traceability. This statement does not constitute a third-party certificate.

Materials supplied into Samsung and Apple programs are screened against customer declarations for EU RoHS restricted substances and REACH candidate-list obligations where applicable. Flammability classification, electrical insulation, battery-related safety evidence and transportation documentation are collected when a supplied component or material requires them. AEMS does not infer finished-product certification from a component certificate; certification decisions remain with the customer and the designated certification or test organization.

###### Upstream supplier and change control

Approved upstream sources are listed in the program-specific approved manufacturer list. A change in resin grade, adhesive chemistry, plating system, alloy, connector source, flex laminate, elastomer formulation or manufacturing site triggers engineering review. The supplier change coordinator assigns a PCN number, obtains comparative data, identifies affected customer programs and prevents production use until required approvals are recorded.

#### Verification, records and deliverables

Program verification is driven by customer requirements and the manufacturing risk assessment. Typical records include incoming material inspection, first-article inspection, torque or retention checks, electrical continuity results, dimensional reports, thermal screening, environmental exposure records, cosmetic inspection, reliability sampling and nonconformance disposition. Where testing is performed for a customer build, the plan number is placed on the traveler and the resulting test record carries the same program and lot identifiers.

###### Samsung controlled records

TP-SAM-ORR-DVT1-006 - DVT1 subassembly verification plan, Rev A.

TR-SAM-ORR-006-03 - DVT1 verification record for USB-C/audio flex and sealing kit, closed 7 August 2026.

FAI-SAM-A56R-0811 - first-article dimensional report for EMI shield and camera-support bracket.

MDR-SAM-ORR-26-08 - controlled material declaration package for the August build.

###### Apple controlled records

CP-APL-NPI-16-044 - released process-control plan for precision subassembly and adhesive conversion.

FAI-APL-16-2026-031 - first-article inspection report, customer drawing revision controlled in the program vault.

PCN-AEMS-APL-2026-019 - pending process-change notice for secondary tooling refurbishment; no material substitution proposed.

###### Standard customer deliverables

Unless the purchase order states otherwise, AEMS provides a certificate of conformance, serialized or lot-level shipment manifest, first-article report when a new revision is introduced, material declaration for controlled materials, approved deviation record where applicable, and a manufacturing change package for any customer-approved process or source change. NPI programs may additionally require line-readiness evidence, capability studies, gauge correlation, golden-sample retention and an end-of-build issue summary.

#### Logistics, traceability and manufacturing location evidence

Finished supplier lots are labeled with customer program code, customer part number, AEMS internal work order, manufacturing site code, line, date code and quantity. The Bac Ninh site code is VN-BN01; Shenzhen is CN-SZ03; and Sriperumbudur is IN-SR02. The manufacturing location printed on the certificate of conformance must match the site that executed the controlled process. Where a lot contains work from more than one AEMS site, the traveler identifies the operation and site sequence rather than listing only the final pack-out location.

Samsung Orion-R subassemblies covered by the current quotation are released from VN-BN01. Apple precision mechanical work under the referenced quote is released from CN-SZ03.

#### Commercial and customer-management references

Commercial quotations are maintained separately from engineering travelers but use the same customer and opportunity identifiers so that tooling, NRE, unit pricing, qualification scope and deliverables can be reconciled during program review. The following references are active within this synthetic statement.

Samsung: Opportunity SAM-ORR-26-041; quotation QT-AEMS-260527-118; commercial owner Priya Nair, Director - Mobile Programs.

Apple: Opportunity APL-NPI-24-118; quotation QT-AEMS-240612-077 Rev C; commercial owner Jason Lin, Senior Director - Strategic Accounts.

Quotation changes that affect manufacturing process, site, material or validation scope are reviewed jointly by commercial, customer engineering and supplier quality before a revised offer is released. Price-only changes do not authorize technical changes to the controlled product configuration.

#### Supplier declaration

AEMS confirms that manufacturing and verification activities performed under the program references in this statement are controlled by customer-approved specifications, released internal work instructions and traceable production records. AEMS will notify the relevant customer before implementing a change that can affect fit, form, function, safety, regulatory compliance, reliability, material composition or manufacturing location.

This synthetic capability statement is intended to resemble a normal enterprise supplier document that a customer, certification reviewer or sourcing team might receive. It is not an authentic document from Samsung, Apple, Foxconn or any other real company, and the commercial relationships described above are fictional.

## Certification Support Addendum

Samsung Orion-R - supplier verification required as supporting certification evidence

##### Certification-support verification scope - Samsung Orion-R

AEMS does not own or issue the Galaxy A56R finished-product certifications. For the Samsung Orion-R DVT1 build, however, the customer certification program identifies certain supplier-controlled verification results as required supporting evidence. The customer master plan TP-A56R-REG-04 Rev B references AEMS supplier plan TP-SAM-ORR-DVT1-006 Rev A for the USB-C/audio flex, gasket, shield and adhesive-kit scope shipped from VN-BN01.

###### Support to North American product-safety certification

For synthetic certification project CERT-A56R-NA-62368-01, Samsung requires AEMS evidence showing that the released USB-C/audio subassembly matches the construction used in the product-safety test plan.

TP-SAM-ORR-DVT1-006 therefore requires the following supplier tests before the lot is released for certification builds:

SUP-SAM-01 - Electrical continuity: verify all controlled VBUS, ground and signal paths against the released flex drawing.

SUP-SAM-02 - Connector retention: sample pull/retention check after soldering and mechanical staking.

SUP-SAM-03 - Ground-path resistance: verify receptacle shell and designated ground features meet the customer resistance limit before final kitting.

SUP-SAM-04 - Gasket compression / placement: inspect the USB sealing gasket for position, thickness and compression-window conformity.

SUP-SAM-05 - Sample-level thermal screen: perform the customer-defined electrical load screen on the released subassembly before shipment to the certification build.

These supplier tests do not replace SAF-A56R-02 or SAF-A56R-06 at finished-product level. Their records are supporting evidence required by the certification program to establish that the installed subassembly is traceable to the released construction.

###### Support to U.S. FCC and EU RED radio/EMC programs

The customer radio plans TP-A56R-FCC-RF-03 Rev A and TP-A56R-RED-EU6-02 Rev A require production-intent shielding, grounding and cable geometry. AEMS therefore retains dimensional inspection of the shield set, lot traceability for conductive materials and continuity records for the USB/audio flex as preconditions to Samsung releasing units for formal radio/EMC testing. If AEMS changes shield material, connector source, conductive gasket or manufacturing site, Samsung compliance engineering reviews whether previously completed certification tests remain representative.

###### Certification-support test records

Execution of TP-SAM-ORR-DVT1-006 produces records under the existing TR-SAM-ORR-006-xx series. Each record identifies the Samsung opportunity/program, AEMS work order, manufacturing site, component revision, supplier-plan test item, result and any deviation. When the lot is allocated to a certification build, the shipment manifest also identifies the customer certification project or test-plan reference supplied on the purchase order. This permits later retrieval from a certification activity to the supplier test plan and individual supporting tests without treating the supplier as the certification authority.

1. Scope and product definition
This specification defines the DVT1 hardware and compliance configuration for the Galaxy A56R 5G smartphone.
The A56R belongs to the Galaxy A5x 5G product family and is developed under internal platform code Orion-R. It is a
handheld 5G NR / LTE terminal with integrated Wi-Fi 6E, Bluetooth, NFC, GNSS, wired USB-C power delivery and 15
W inductive charging.
SM-A568B/DS
EU/UK dual-SIM variant; 8 GB RAM / 128 GB storage and 12 GB / 256 GB orderable memory configurations.
SM-A568U1
U.S. unlocked variant; one physical nano-SIM plus eSIM; 12 GB RAM / 256 GB storage baseline.
Industrial design
Graphite and Ice Blue finishes; aluminum midframe with reinforced polycarbonate rear cover.
Intended environment
Consumer handheld use; indoor/outdoor; altitude up to 3,000 m; pollution degree 2 during charging.

10. Certification programs and required verification
The master regulatory qualification plan TP-A56R-REG-04 Rev B controls the DVT1 certification workstreams. Each
certification or conformity-assessment activity below is executed under a named sub-plan so that required tests,
samples and resulting records can be traced to the specific approval activity. The test laboratory shall confirm the
exact normative clauses, limits and national deviations before formal execution.
10.1 North American product safety certification
Synthetic certification project CERT-A56R-NA-62368-01 covers the North American product-safety evaluation of the
finished A56R construction using the UL/CSA 62368-1 requirements accepted at project opening. The certification
project is executed under TP-A56R-SAF-62368-01 Rev A. Closure of the safety certification requires completion of the
following project tests or documented technical justification where a test is not applicable:
• SAF-A56R-01 - Abnormal operation and single-fault evaluation: exercise charging, processor/RF load and
representative fault conditions while monitoring temperatures and protective response.
• SAF-A56R-02 - 45 W PPS temperature-rise evaluation: measure USB-C connector, charger/PBA, battery and
accessible enclosure temperatures in the worst-case negotiated charging mode.
• SAF-A56R-03 - Dielectric-strength and insulation safeguard verification: verify applicable insulation paths and no
breakdown after conditioning.
• SAF-A56R-04 - Touch-current / leakage-current assessment: evaluate accessible conductive parts and charging
conditions as applicable to the submitted configuration.
• SAF-A56R-05 - Battery charging safeguard verification: confirm the 0-45 °C charging inhibit, NTC response, pack
protection and software timeout functions.
• SAF-A56R-06 - USB-C ground-path continuity: confirm connector shell, daughterboard ground springs and
aluminum midframe remain electrically bonded before and after mechanical conditioning.
Formal records from this plan are retained in File E512847, Volume 1, Section 3 or the project evidence package linked from that file.
10.2 IECEE CB product-safety evaluation
Synthetic CB project CERT-A56R-CB-62368-01 uses IEC 62368-1:2023 as the international safety baseline. The CB
evaluation is controlled by TP-A56R-CB-62368-02 Rev A, which reuses qualified evidence from SAF-A56R-01
through SAF-A56R-05 where the construction, sample condition and test method are equivalent. National deviations or
country-specific additions are documented as supplemental test items rather than assumed from the base IEC result.
10.3 Rechargeable battery safety certification evidence
Battery safety certification package CERT-A56R-BAT-62133-01 applies to Samsung SDI pack EB-BA568ABY Rev B
and is governed by TP-A56R-BAT-62133-01 Rev B. The project plan requires battery-level and product-interface
evidence sufficient to support IEC 62133-2:2017 + A1:2021 and the A56R charging-safeguard review.
• BAT-A56R-01 - Overcharge protection functional test on the controlled pack/protection network.
• BAT-A56R-02 - External short-circuit response with protective device operation recorded.
• BAT-A56R-03 - Forced-discharge / over-discharge protection verification for the controlled pack configuration.
• BAT-A56R-04 - Thermal conditioning and temperature-cycling evidence for the pack and protection network.

10.4 FCC equipment authorization - U.S. model
For model SM-A568U1, synthetic equipment-authorization project CERT-A56R-FCC-RF-01 is executed under
TP-A56R-FCC-RF-03 Rev A. The plan identifies the enabled cellular, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and NFC configurations and
requires formal test evidence for the applicable FCC rule parts. Project test cases include:
• RF-A56R-US-01 - Conducted transmitter output-power verification for enabled radio modes and bands.
• RF-A56R-US-02 - Occupied bandwidth and band-edge measurements using the production RF configuration.
• RF-A56R-US-03 - Radiated and conducted spurious-emission evaluation in representative worst-case operating
modes.
• EMC-A56R-US-04 - Part 15 digital/radiated-emission test, including the 11 V PPS charging condition identified by
pre-compliance record TR-A56R-PRE-EMC-017 Rev A.
• RF-A56R-US-05 - RF exposure / SAR assessment for the final antenna configuration and supported transmit
positions.
10.5 EU Radio Equipment Directive conformity assessment - EU/UK model
For model SM-A568B/DS, synthetic conformity-assessment project CERT-A56R-RED-EU6-01 is controlled by
TP-A56R-RED-EU6-02 Rev A. This is a regulatory conformity assessment rather than a voluntary product-safety
certification. The plan requires evidence that the released radio SKU and finished construction satisfy the applicable
RED essential requirements.
• RF-A56R-EU-01 - 2.4 GHz radio test set for Wi-Fi/Bluetooth functions using the applicable EN 300 328 requirements.
• RF-A56R-EU-02 - 5 GHz RLAN test set using EN 301 893 where the enabled channels make it applicable.
• EMC-A56R-EU-03 - Radio EMC assessment using the applicable EN 301 489 series requirements.
• RF-A56R-EU-04 - RF exposure / SAR assessment for the final handset configuration.
• SAF-A56R-EU-05 - Safety evidence review using the IEC/EN 62368-1 product-safety file where applicable.
10.6 Cellular industry certification
Where required by the target operator or market-access program, synthetic cellular certification project
CERT-A56R-PTCRB-01 is executed under TP-A56R-PTCRB-01 Rev A. The plan calls for configured 5G NR/LTE RF
conformance, protocol/conformance and band-combination verification using the production radio SKU. This industry
certification is maintained separately from FCC or RED regulatory authorization.
11. Test-plan hierarchy and execution control
TP-A56R-REG-04 Rev B is the master plan. It defines sample allocation, configuration lock, witness requirements,
retest disposition and the set of subordinate plans used by each certification workstream. A test may support more
than one certification only when the sample configuration, method and acceptance basis are equivalent and the
certification owner accepts the shared record.
• TP-A56R-SAF-62368-01 Rev A - North American product-safety certification tests.
• TP-A56R-CB-62368-02 Rev A - IECEE CB product-safety evaluation and national-deviation supplements.
• TP-A56R-BAT-62133-01 Rev B - battery safety certification evidence for EB-BA568ABY Rev B.
• TP-A56R-FCC-RF-03 Rev A - U.S. radio/equipment-authorization testing for SM-A568U1.
• TP-A56R-RED-EU6-02 Rev A - EU RED radio/EMC/RF-exposure assessment for SM-A568B/DS.
• TP-A56R-PTCRB-01 Rev A - cellular industry certification where required.
• TP-A56R-IP67-01 Rev B - IEC 60529 ingress validation; this supports the IP67 product claim and is not treated as a
certification scheme.

12. Certification closeout evidence
A certification workstream may be closed only after its controlling test plan has either completed every required test or
documented an approved non-applicability rationale. Each formal record shall identify the certification project, test-plan
number, test-case identifier, sample serial number, hardware/BOM revision, firmware build, laboratory, date, result and
any deviation or retest. Open failures, configuration substitutions or deviations affecting a required test remain linked to
the certification project until disposition is approved.
